item.title: EV కొనేముందు ఈ Video చూడకపోతే, ₹లక్షలు బూడిదే! Dark Truth of Electric Vehicles in India| ThirdEye
item.description:
మీరు కొత్తగా Electric Vehicle (EV) కొందామని ప్లాన్ చేస్తున్నారా? "పెట్రోల్ రేట్లు పెరిగిపోతున్నాయి.. EV కొంటే నెలకు వేల రూపాయలు ఆదా అవుతాయి" అని Showroom వాళ్ళు చెప్పే మాటలు విని బండి బుక్ చేసేస్తున్నారా?
ఆగండి! ఒక్క క్షణం ఈ పూర్తి వాస్తవాలు చూడండి.
ఈ వీడియోలో మనం ఎలక్ట్రిక్ వాహనాల మార్కెట్ వెనుక ఉన్న కఠినమైన వాస్తవాలు, ఎవ్వరూ బయటకు చెప్పని గణిత లెక్కలు, మరియు దాగి ఉన్న ఖర్చులను పారదర్శకంగా విశ్లేషించాం.
📌 ఈ వీడియోలో మీరు తెలుసుకోబోయే ముఖ్య విషయాలు: 1. ₹10,900 కోట్ల PM E-DRIVE స్కీమ్ నిజంగా సామాన్యులకు ఉపయోగపడుతోందా? 2. ఎలక్ట్రిక్ టూ-వీలర్ & కార్ల వాస్తవ కొనుగోలు ఖర్చు vs పెట్రోల్ వాహనాలు. 3. రోజుకు ఎన్ని కిలోమీటర్లు తిరిగితే EV లాభదాయకం? మీ డ్రైవింగ్ దూరం ఎంత ఉండాలి? 4. హోమ్ ఛార్జింగ్ (రూ. 0.21/కి.మీ) vs పబ్లిక్ ఫాస్ట్ ఛార్జింగ్ ధరల వ్యత్యాసం. 5. అపార్ట్‌మెంట్లలో ఛార్జింగ్ సమస్యలు & నిబంధనల చిక్కులు. 6. హైవే ప్రయాణాల్లో రేంజ్ డ్రాప్ (AC, ట్రాఫిక్ ప్రభావం) మరియు పనిచేయని పబ్లిక్ ఛార్జర్లు. 7. 2-3 ఏళ్ల తర్వాత Used EV రీసేల్ మార్కెట్ మరియు బ్యాటరీ రీప్లేస్‌మెంట్ వాస్తవాలు.
---
⚠️ Disclaimer: ఈ వీడియో ఎలక్ట్రిక్ వాహనాలకు వ్యతిరేకంగా రూపొందించినది కాదు. ఒక వినియోగదారుడిగా మీ కష్టార్జితాన్ని సరైన విధంగా ఖర్చు చేయడానికి అవసరమైన గణిత విశ్లేషణ, మార్కెట్ డేటా మరియు వాస్తవ పరిస్థితులను వివరించడమే దీని ముఖ్య ఉద్దేశం. వాహన కొనుగోలు నిర్ణయం తీసుకునే ముందు మీ వ్యక్తిగత ప్రయాణ అవసరాలు మరియు ఆర్థిక స్థితిని పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకోండి.

భూమి కింద వందల కిలోమీటర్ల లోతులో, మనకంటే అడ్వాన్స్‌డ్ టెక్నాలజీతో జీవిస్తున్న ఒక రహస్య నగరం ఉందా? 'అగర్త' వెనుక దాగి ఉన్న అసలు నిజం ఏంటి?

Ee video lo, manam 'Agartha' ane oka mind-blowing underground city mystery gurinchi telusukundam. Bhoomi lopala nijangane inko prapancham unda? 1938 lo oka powerful German regime enduku Tibet ki secret expedition pampindi? Admiral Byrd diary lo unna nammaleni vishayalu enti? Ee ancient fantasy story present digital era lo ela oka dangerous trend ga marindo clear ga discuss cheddam.
In this deep dive into the Hollow Earth theory and the Agartha mystery, we cover: 🔸 The Underground Paradise: The bizarre belief of a highly advanced, crystal-built city inside the Earth with its own miniature sun and telepathic citizens. 🔸 Admiral Byrd's Secret Diary: The incredible 1947 story of a US Navy officer who allegedly flew into the hollow earth and interacted with a highly advanced civilization. 🔸 The 1938 Secret Mission: How a WW2-era German regime became dangerously obsessed with this myth and sent a highly funded expedition to the Himalayas to find the entrance. 🔸 The Internet Phenomenon: The shocking reality of how this ancient myth has recently resurfaced as a highly manipulative and radicalizing psychological trend on modern social media platforms. 🔸 The Scientific Truth: What seismology and the Kola Superdeep Borehole actually tell us about the Earth's core, proving the physical impossibility of a Hollow Earth.
What do you think? Is Agartha just a psychological fantasy, or is there a deeper mystery hidden from us? Let me know your thoughts in the comments!

item.title: Docker CRASH COURSE For Beginners | Docker Container, Docker Image, Dockerfile, Docker Compose
item.description:
In this video, I’m taking you through Docker from the ground up, focusing on how containers actually work and how the pieces fit together in real-world engineering environments, not just which commands to memorize.
I’m breaking down the core concepts behind Docker, including containers vs. virtual machines, Docker’s architecture, images and containers, Dockerfiles, image layers and caching, container lifecycle management, volumes and bind mounts, container networking, and Docker Compose.
The goal is to give you a strong mental model of Docker so you can start building, running, and troubleshooting containerized applications with confidence, while building the foundation you need for modern DevOps, cloud, backend, and AI engineering workflows.

item.title: Reacher Season 4 RECAP: Episodes 1-3 Breakdown (Everything You Missed)
item.description:
2026 brings Jack Reacher back for Season 4 — and the first three episodes just dropped, throwing him straight into the most dangerous mystery of the series yet. In this recap, we break down everything that happened in Episodes 1-3 of Reacher Season 4: "The City of Brotherly Love," "Cage Fight," and "One Small Step."
This season is based on Gone Tomorrow, Lee Child's 13th Jack Reacher novel, with the story relocated to Philadelphia. It kicks off when Reacher encounters a distraught stranger on a subway — and after the meeting goes horribly wrong, he gets pulled into a complicated, deadly conspiracy involving enemies from the highest levels of power. DocumentaryTube Enstarz
We cover the biggest twists, new characters, and standout action sequences from the premiere episodes, plus what they set up for the rest of the season. Alan Ritchson returns as the iconic ex-military cop, and this season has already been teased as one of the most action-heavy yet. High On Films

item.description:

ఎయిర్ ఇండియా ఫ్లైట్ AI 2379: 300 అడుగుల డ్రాప్ వెనుక కాక్‌పిట్ లో అసలు ఏం జరిగింది? పైలట్ డ్రగ్స్ రిపోర్ట్ లో ఉన్న నిజం ఏంటి?
For Business Inquiries & Brand Collaborations: 📧 vrfactsofficial1969@gmail.com
Ee video lo, Air India AI 2379 flight lo jarigina technical and investigation details gurinchi deep ga discuss cheddam. Mundu weather problem anukunna ee incident, internal reports bayataki vachaka oka pedda mystery ga marindi. Asalu cockpit lo stall warning enduku vachindi? Autopilot enduku disconnect ayyindi? Pilot drug test report venuka unna science enti?
In this deep dive into aviation science and the official investigation, we cover: 🔸 The Cockpit Reality: What exactly happened when the autopilot disconnected and the flight experienced a sudden pitch-up. 🔸 Understanding 'Stall' & 'Negative-G': The real physics behind the 300-foot drop and why passengers were thrown to the ceiling. 🔸 The 3 Hydraulic Systems Mystery: Did the A320 really lose all three independent hydraulic systems for 6 seconds, or was it a computer glitch? 🔸 The Pilot's Drug Test: Decoding the "non-negative" drug report of the Captain, the ALPA response, and the difference between the presence of a substance and active impairment. 🔸 The Ongoing Investigation: How AAIB, BEA, and Airbus are using the Black Box (FDR & CVR) to uncover the final truth behind this aviation incident.
Join us as we unravel the technical facts behind the headlines! Mee opinion lo idhi human error aa leka technical glitch aa? Kinda comment cheyandi.

item.title: 🚨 BABA Vanga 2026 FUTURE Prediction Warning Real? | Untold Columbia Earthquake Secret 🔮 | VR Raja
item.description:
🚨 BABA Vanga 2026 FUTURE Prediction Warning Real? | Untold Columbia Earthquake Secret 🔮 | VR Raja
Colombia లో వచ్చిన powerful **7.4 Magnitude Earthquake** కొన్ని గంటల్లోనే వందలాది families జీవితాలను మార్చేసింది. Buildings damage అయ్యాయి, వేలాది మంది affected అయ్యారు, rescue teams rubble కింద trapped అయిన survivors కోసం search operations కొనసాగిస్తున్నాయి.
కానీ ఈ disaster మధ్య Social Mediaలో మరో shocking claim viral అయింది — **ఈ Earthquake ని Baba Vanga ముందే predict చేసిందా?** 🔮
ఈ వీడియోలో headlines మాత్రమే కాదు, **Colombia Earthquake Ground Reality**ని completeగా చూద్దాం.
Rubble కింద చిక్కుకున్న ఒక చిన్న baby మరియు ఆమె motherని aliveగా rescue చేసిన emotional incident, గంటల పాటు Cable Carలో trapped అయిన passengersని safeగా బయటకు తీసుకొచ్చిన rescue operation, survivors నుంచి వచ్చే చిన్న sound కూడా miss కాకూడదని complete silence maintain చేస్తూ rubble మధ్య search చేస్తున్న rescue teams — ఇవన్నీ ఈ disaster ఎంత seriousగా ఉందో చూపిస్తున్నాయి.
అసలు Colombiaలో ఇలాంటి powerful earthquakes ఎందుకు వస్తాయి?
🌍 **Nazca Plate, South American Plate, Caribbean Plate** మధ్య జరిగే tectonic movements ఏమిటి?
🌋 Colombia **Pacific Ring of Fire** regionకి ఎందుకు connectedగా ఉంది?
🌊 Climate Change, melting ice, sea-level changes వంటి factors earthquake faultsపై ఏమైనా influence చూపగలవా?
ఈ scientific sideని కూడా simpleగా understand చేసుకుందాం.
అయితే ఈ storyలో biggest mystery — **Baba Vanga 2026 Predictions.**
Earthquake జరిగిన వెంటనే “Baba Vanga ముందే చెప్పింది”, “2026 prediction నిజమైంది” అంటూ posts, reels, videos viral అయ్యాయి.
కానీ ఆమె నిజంగా **Colombiaలో earthquake వస్తుందని specificగా predict చేసిందా?**
Exact country, date, magnitude గురించి ముందే documented evidence ఉందా?
లేక disaster జరిగిన తర్వాత vague predictionని real eventకి connect చేస్తున్నామా?
అదే విధంగా **Nostradamus 2026 Predictions** పేరుతో viral అవుతున్న claimsలో original writings ఏవి, later interpretations ఏవి అనే difference కూడా చూద్దాం.
ఎందుకంటే…
“Futureలో earthquakes, floods, wars, disasters వస్తాయి” అని generalగా చెప్పడం ఒక prediction.
కానీ **exact place + exact time + exact event ముందే చెప్పడం** completely different.
ఇక్కడే **Prediction vs Coincidence vs Psychology vs Scientific Evidence** మధ్య అసలు difference తెలుస్తుంది.

item.title: UPI Charges Explained: Google Pay, PhonePe వాడేవాళ్ళకి Bad News? ThirdEye
item.description:
The Shocking Truth About UPI Charges in India! Are Google Pay & PhonePe charging you? 💸
Have you recently noticed supermarkets asking for cash instead of UPI? There is a massive rumor spreading across family WhatsApp groups that UPI is no longer free. In this video, we break down the reality behind the "Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026" passed in the Lok Sabha on August 6th
What you will learn in this video: • How the complex UPI backend actually routes your money in seconds. • Why the government spent over ₹11,000 crores to keep UPI free and why subsidies are ending. • The truth about Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman's statement on zero customer charges. • What Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) is and how the 0.25% to 0.4% charge on transactions over ₹2,000 impacts large businesses like Dmart and Amazon. • The reality of the 1.1% interchange fee on Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPIs). • The hidden twist: How giant corporations might quietly increase product prices to cover their new UPI fees, affecting the common man.
Your daily payments at local vegetable vendors, auto drivers, and kirana stores remain 100% free and safe!
Don't forget to LIKE, SHARE, and SUBSCRIBE for more honest financial breakdowns!
Drop your thoughts in the comments below: Do you think companies will pass this new UPI tax onto us? Let's discuss! 👇

దేశంలో, మరీ ముఖ్యంగా తెలుగు రాష్ట్రాల్లో, జరుగుతున్న రాజకీయ, సామాజిక, ఆర్థిక, సాంస్కృతిక పరిణామాల మీద విశ్లేషణను అందించే ప్రయత్నం ఈ చానెల్. లోతైన, అర్థవంతమైన, పక్షపాత రహిత వ్యాఖ్యానాలు అందించడం ఛానెల్ ప్రధానోద్దేశం. ఏ ఒక్క రాజకీయ భావజాలాన్ని, రాజకీయ పార్టీని నెత్తిన పెట్టుకోకుండా, స్వతంత్ర భావాలతో వ్యవహరించే ఈ ఛానెల్ ను సబ్ స్క్రైబ్ చేసి, ప్రోత్సహించండి.
My books: i) Maverick Messiah - A Political Biography of N.T. Rama Rao, and ii) Amaravati Vivadalu-Vastavalu (Telugu). Both available on www.amazon.in

ఒక బట్టల రంగు దేశవ్యాప్తంగా ఇంత పెద్ద డిబేట్ కి ఎందుకు దారితీస్తుంది? కేరళలో కాషాయ రంగుని నిజంగానే బ్యాన్ చేశారా? ఇండియన్ హాకీ టీమ్ జెర్సీ బ్లూ నుంచి ఆరెంజ్ కలర్ కి మారడం వెనుక అసలు రీజన్స్ ఏంటి? 1931 లో మన నేషనల్ ఫ్లాగ్ ని డిజైన్ చేస్తున్నప్పుడు కాషాయ రంగు గురించి మన లీడర్స్ తీసుకున్న షాకింగ్ డెసిషన్స్ ఏంటో ఈ వీడియోలో క్లియర్ గా చూద్దాం.

item.description:
🚨 BREAKING Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg Apologizes to India | PM Modi Video Deleted? | VR Raja
ఇండియాకి మెటా CEO మార్క్ జుకర్ బర్గ్ ఎందుకు సారీ చెప్పాడు? ప్రధాని మోదీ గారి అఫీషియల్ వీడియోని 5 గంటల పాటు ఇంస్టాగ్రామ్ ఎందుకు డిలీట్ చేసింది? ఫేస్బుక్, ఇంస్టాగ్రామ్ అల్గారిథమ్స్ మన పిల్లల బ్రెయిన్స్ ని ఎలా నాశనం చేస్తున్నాయి?
For Business Inquiries & Brand Collaborations: 📧 vrfactsofficial1969@gmail.com
Ee video lo, Meta platforms (Facebook & Instagram) paina India teesukunna serious action gurinchi, and social media algorithms mana mindsets ni ela manipulate chestunnayi anna dark reality gurinchi deep ga discuss cheddam. PM Modi video deletion nundi BBC investigation lo bayatapadina shocking facts varaku anni cover chesamu.
In this deep dive into Social Media Reality & Tech Geopolitics, we cover: 🔸 BBC Investigation: How Instagram's algorithmic moderation allowed illegal CSAM (Child Sexual Abuse Material) ads on its platform. 🔸 PM Modi's Video Deletion: The mystery behind the 5-hour deletion of the Prime Minister's official video on the NEET issue and the IT Ministry's strict action. 🔸 The 'Safe Harbour' Threat: What is Section 79(3) of the IT Act? Why is the Indian government warning Meta to cancel their intermediary status and treat them as publishers? 🔸 Algorithmic Manipulation: How Engagement-based ranking, Filter Bubbles, and Echo Chambers are polarizing society and spreading extremist ideologies. 🔸 Impact on Kids & Teens: The dark truth behind the "For You Page" and how unrealistic standards and dangerous challenges are destroying mental health. 🔸 The Solution: What is 'Engagement Tax', global laws like the EU's Digital Services Act, and how parents can protect their children.
Social media algorithms gurinchi telusukunna tharuvatha mee opinion enti? Manam algorithms ki banisalam avuthunnama? Comment your thoughts below!

Taskmaster (AU)
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Taskmaster (AU).

Tom Gleeson stars as the Taskmaster, with Tom Cashman his devoted assistant. Each week the two Toms set five comedians a range of ridiculous tasks designed to bamboozle brains and put funny bones to the test.

Who'll master the tasks? The cleverest clogs will score the most points from the Taskmaster, while bemusement and bafflement will be rewarded with the fewest points. At series' end, the comedian with the most points will be crowned Taskmaster champion.

item.title: Alone Australia
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Alone Australia.

Follow ten brave Australians who are dropped in the merciless Tasmanian wilderness, completely isolated from the world and each other, stripped of modern possessions, contact and comforts, to self-document their experience. Who will survive the longest?

item.title: Colin From Accounts
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Colin From Accounts.

Centred on Ashley and Gordon, two single(ish), complex humans who are brought together by a car accident and an injured dog, Colin From Accounts is about flawed, funny people choosing each other and being brave enough to show their true self, scars and all, as they navigate life together.

item.title: Lucky (2026)
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Lucky (2026).

When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life — and a way out.

item.title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe.

Set in the future, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom is tasked with restoring reality after he breaks a device built by Sheldon, Leonard and Howard, accidentally bringing about a multiverse Armageddon.Stuart is aided in this quest by his girlfriend Denise, geologist friend Bert, and quantum physicist/all-around pain in the ass Barry Kripke. Along the way, they meet alternate-universe versions of characters we've come to know and love from The Big Bang Theory. As the title implies, things don't go well.

item.title: Dr Vikrant Singh Thakur
Bhogapuram Airport: ఈ ఒక్క వీడియో చూస్తే మొత్తం కథ అర్థమవుతుంది |ThirdEye
item.description:
For decades, the North Andhra region watched from afar as cities like Hyderabad grew rapidly.
Today, the Bhogapuram International Airport is finally a reality, but it has triggered a fierce credit war between two political titans: #chandrababu Naidu and Jagan Mohan Reddy. Who actually deserves the credit for this mega-project? Did Naidu's early vision lay the foundation, or did Jagan's execution of the "middle stretch" make it happen?. We break down the paper trail, the controversies, and the final verdict.
Before Bhogapuram Airport could take flight, it faced a massive legal hurdle. In 2016, farmers approached the High Court, questioning why the land acquisition layout looked like a twisted "Octopus" instead of a standard square. Why were specific real estate plots excluded? This controversy led to a High Court stay and forced the government to drastically shrink the project. Discover the early real estate battles that almost killed the airport.
In 2015, #jaganmohanreddy strongly protested the proposed 15,000-acre "Aerotropolis" at Bhogapuram, questioning why it needed so much land compared to airports in Chennai or Cochin. Yet, years later as Chief Minister, he took ownership of the project. Why the sudden reversal? We dive into how the project was scaled down to 2,200 acres , how the GMR deal was finalized, and the truth behind the initial land acquisition controversies.
The MANSAS trust, chaired by Ashok Gajapathi Raju, donated 136 acres of prime real estate next to the #bhogapuramairport to the #gmrgroup for an #aviation training campus. Supporters call it a royal charity meant to generate jobs for North #andhrapradesh youth. Critics argue it was a calculated business strategy to skyrocket the value of surrounding lands owned by the trust and secure long-term influence. What is the real story behind this massive land deal?

item.title: Varalakshmi Vratham Simple Pooja Guide - How to Perform at Home | Complete Step-by-Step Puja Guide
item.description:
Performing Varalakshmi Vratham at home? In this complete step-by-step guide, we show you a simple and respectful way to perform Varalakshmi Vratham at home—even when you are doing it for the first time or do not have anyone beside you to guide you.
You do not need fifty puja items, expensive decorations or difficult Sanskrit mantras. This video takes you through the complete vratham slowly and clearly, from preparing the puja space and kalasham to worshipping the toram, offering naivedyam and performing harati.
In this video, you will learn:
• How to prepare the Varalakshmi puja space • The essential puja items you need • How to prepare the kalasham correctly • How to arrange the coconut, mango leaves and blouse piece • How to prepare the Varalakshmi toram with nine knots • The meaning behind the nine knots • How to begin the puja with Vinayaka prayer • How to take the sankalpam • How to invite Varalakshmi into the kalasham • How to offer turmeric, kumkum, akshata and flowers • A simple Lakshmi mantra you can chant at home • How to offer naivedyam • The traditional story of Charumati and Varalakshmi Vratham • How to worship and tie the toram • How to perform the final harati • What to do with the kalasham, coconut, rice, flowers and other puja items the following day
Simple mantras used in this puja:
**Vinayaka Mantra**
Om Gam Ganapataye Namah
**Varalakshmi Avahanam**
Om Shri Varalakshmyai Namah Avahayami Sthapayami Pujayami
**Lakshmi Mantra**
Om Shreem Mahalakshmyai Namah
Chant the mantras slowly and with devotion. Do not worry if your pronunciation is not perfect or if you make an unintentional mistake. Fold your hands, ask Lakshmi to forgive you and continue the puja peacefully.
Frequently asked questions answered in this video:
Can you eat before performing Varalakshmi Vratham?
Can unmarried women participate?
Can men and children take part in the puja?
What should you do if you make a mistake?
How long should you wear the toram?
What should you do with the kalasham water?
Can the coconut and rice be used after the puja?
What should you do with the setup the following morning?
For this simple vratham, you may have fruit or milk before the puja and eat your main meal after completing it. Never fast against medical advice or in a way that harms your health.
Varalakshmi Vratham date and muhurtham:
**Varalakshmi Vratham Date:** Friday, August 21, 2026 **Puja Muhurtham:** Morning (Simha Lagna): 06:53 AM – 08:56 AM. Afternoon (Vrishchika Lagna): 01:35 PM – 03:54 PM. Evening/Twilight (Kumbha Lagna): 07:39 PM – 09:05 PM (Highly recommended for Lakshmi worship). Midnight (Vrishabha Lagna): 12:03 AM – 01:58 AM (Aug 22).
Please check the pinned comment for any updated timing or puja information.
Varalakshmi represents prosperity in its fullest form—not money alone, but good health, food in the home, knowledge, courage, family harmony, peace and the ability to help another person.
Lakshmi does not remain only in homes with silver kalashams, expensive jewellery or elaborate flower decorations. She remains where the home is cared for, food is respected, women are honoured, people earn honestly and prosperity is shared responsibly.
Please share this video with someone performing Varalakshmi Vratham—especially someone living away from her family or doing the puja without anyone beside her to guide her.
Your share may become the guidance she was searching for.
May Varalakshmi bless your home with health, harmony, courage, knowledge, abundance and peace.
**Om Shreem Mahalakshmyai Namah.**
Subscribe to **The Temple Girl** for more temple histories, spiritual traditions and simple puja guides.

item.title: Cloud Security Concepts CRASH COURSE
item.description:
Here’s the simplest explanation of the most important concepts that are often asked repeatedly.
• Authentication vs Authorization → Authentication verifies your identity → Authorization checks your permissions
• MFA vs SSO → MFA adds extra verification layers → SSO lets you login once for multiple apps
• IAM vs RBAC → IAM manages identities across cloud infrastructure → RBAC manages permissions inside a system using roles
• Encryption vs Hashing → Encryption scrambles data reversibly with a key → Hashing secures data with a permanent, one-way value
• TLS vs mTLS → TLS is a one-way verification of the server → mTLS is a two-way mutual verification of both sides
• IDS vs IPS → IDS monitors and alerts you of a threat → IPS monitors and actively blocks the threat
• Vulnerability vs Exploit → Vulnerability is a weakness in your infrastructure → Exploit is the technique used to abuse that weakness
• Phishing vs Spoofing → Phishing tricks a person into giving up data → Spoofing tricks a system by faking an identity
Watch till the end to know about more important concepts!

item.title: NEET Scam Wasn't What You Think |Complete History of NEET Paper Leaks (2015–2026)| ThirdEye
item.description:
📌 In this episode
0:00 Introduction 0:43 BEFORE NEET EXISTED 7:22 THE DEAD YEARS — AND THE FIRST LEAK 8:51 NEET RETURNS — AND LEAKS AGAIN 10:54 TWO EXAMS, SAME YEAR 15:48 Final Statement
NEET Paper Leaks didn't begin in 2024. They didn't even begin under one political party.
In this documentary, we go back to the beginning of NEET and uncover every major paper leak, every government, every education minister, and the forgotten history that rarely gets discussed.
Instead of asking "Who is guilty?", this video asks a different question:
"Did both political parties fail the students?"

item.description: Opening in theaters on August 7 is ‘Tony,’ directed by Matt Johnson, and starring Dominic Sessa, Emilia Jones, Dagmara Domińczyk, Rich Sommer, Stavros Halkias, Leo Woodall, and Antonio Banderas.Related Article: Rose Byrne and Dominic Sessa Talk 'Tow' and the True Story It's Based OnInitial ThoughtsBiopics tend to follow one of two well-worn paths: either they try frantically to document the subject’s entire life, often resulting in a race from event to event with little context or depth, or they focus on one specific period in that person’s history, usually documenting a transitional period of some kind that marked a definitive turning point in their life.

item.title: NEET to Politics | How a Student Movement Became Picnic, Propaganda & Politics
item.description:

item.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) In 2 MInutes!
item.description:
Vishakha Sadhwani: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) In 2 MInutes!
Retrieval architecture is quietly becoming one of the most important concepts in AI system design interviews.
Companies increasingly want engineers who understand production RAG workflows, agent orchestration, retrieval accuracy, and hallucination reduction.
These are the architectures that evolved Uber’s production workflows for Genie.
• Traditional RAG → Retrieve semantically similar documents from vector databases. → Fast and simple for standard retrieval workflows.
• Agentic RAG / Enhanced Agentic RAG → Uses agents to decide which tools and retrieval workflows to use. → Better for complex, multi-step reasoning and engineering queries.
• Corrective RAG → Adds evaluation and self-correction layers before returning answers. → Helps reduce weak retrievals and hallucinations.
Learn these early if you want to build stronger AI Engineering fundamentals.

item.title: India's First Private Rocket to Orbit & How Vikram-1 Shattered India's Space Monopoly
item.description:
On July 18, 2026, India quietly made history.
A startup from Hyderabad Skyroot Aerospace successfully launched Vikram-1 into orbit, becoming the first private Indian company to achieve an orbital launch.
But this isn't just the story of one rocket.
It's the story of how India opened the doors to private spaceflight, how two former ISRO scientists built a billion-dollar company, and why this mission could redefine India's future in the global space industry.
In this documentary, we break down:
• Why Vikram-1 matters • Skyroot's incredible journey • ISRO's role • IN-SPACe reforms • Mission Aagaman • India's growing commercial space industry

item.title: 20 MUST-KNOW System Design Concepts For Interviews
item.description:
Vishakha Sadhwani: 20 MUST-KNOW System Design Concepts For Interviews
I’ve seen that many engineers understand the tools, but still mix up similar-looking concepts when discussing cloud system design concepts.
Here’s the simplest explanation of some of the most important topics.
• Forward Proxy vs Reverse Proxy → Forward Proxy protects the client → Reverse Proxy protects the server
• CDN vs Cache → CDN delivers content closer to users → Cache stores frequently accessed data
• Load Balancer vs API Gateway → Load Balancer distributes traffic → API Gateway controls and routes API requests
• Monolith vs Microservices → Monolith keeps everything in one application → Microservices split functionality into independent services
• DNS vs Service Discovery → DNS finds public services on the internet → Service Discovery finds services inside distributed systems
Watch till the end to understand all of them, and subscribe for more!

item.title: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin.

Based on the series by acclaimed Christian novelist Stephen R. Lawhead, The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin is a unique retelling of the Arthurian legend, not set in the Medieval age of knights in shining armor, but in an earlier time — the end of Roman Britain when pagan tribes warred with Saxon and Pict invaders, and with each other, and the idea of a unified Britain was only a dream. In this tumultuous world Merlin, the son of an Atlantean princess and the bard, Taliesen, pursues his father's vision of a Kingdom of Summer — a Britain unified in peace. But to achieve this dream, Merlin will have to overcome ancient evils and navigate both the fall of the Roman occupation and the rise of Christianity in search of a king who can unite the Island of the Mighty.

item.title: AI Engineer Basics CRASH COURSE!
item.description:
Vishakha Sadhwani: AI Engineer Basics CRASH COURSE!
Here’s the simplest explanation of some of the most important AI concepts every engineer must know.
• AI vs Machine Learning → AI teaches machines to perform intelligent tasks → Machine Learning is how systems learn patterns from data
• Machine Learning vs Generative AI → Machine Learning predicts and classifies → Generative AI creates new content like text, code, images, and audio
• LLM vs AI Agent → LLM responds to prompts → Agents use tools, memory, and workflows to complete tasks
• Training vs Inference → Training teaches the model → Inference uses the trained model
• RAG vs Fine-Tuning → RAG retrieves external knowledge at runtime → Fine-Tuning changes model behavior through additional training
• Prompt Engineering vs Context Engineering → Prompt Engineering improves instructions → Context Engineering shapes the entire workflow around the model
• API vs MCP → APIs connect to individual services → MCP standardizes tool usage for AI systems
Watch till the end to know more about the fundamentals of modern AI systems.

item.title: Why Does Jagannath Fall Sick Before Rath Yatra? | Mystery of Puri Jagannath Rath Yatra 2026
item.description:
Why does Jagannath fall sick for 15 days before Rath Yatra?
Every year before Rath Yatra, Jagannath, Balabhadra, and Subhadra Devi disappear from public darshan after Snana Yatra. Devotees say Jagannath falls sick after the grand ceremonial bath and enters Anasara, a sacred period of rest, recovery, and deep longing. But this is not just a strange temple custom. It reveals one of the most beautiful ideas of Puri: Jagannath is not treated as a distant God, but as a living presence who wakes up, bathes, eats, rests, falls sick, recovers, travels, and returns to his people.
In this video, we explore the deeper meaning behind Snana Yatra, Anasara, Nava Yauvana Darshan, Netrotsava, Rath Yatra, the wooden form of Jagannath, the mystery of Nabakalebara, Brahma Padartha, Mahaprasad, and why the streets of Puri become a moving temple when the chariots begin to roll.
Rath Yatra is not just a festival. It is the return of Jagannath after 15 days of waiting. A God with no visible hands, moved by human hands. A God with no visible feet, carried by human devotion. A God who comes out of the temple so everyone can receive darshan.
Jai Jagannath.
Download the Temple Girl Kids app at templegirl.com for bedtime stories from India’s temples.
#Jagannath #RathYatra #PuriJagannath #JagannathTemple #SnanaYatra #Anasara #Nabakalebara #Mahaprasad #TempleGirl #IndianTemples #SanatanaDharma #Odisha #Puri #JaiJagannath

item.title: MAVIGUN is Greater Amaravati! FAKE STRATEGY EXPOSED! ThirdEye
item.description:
Can a state change its heart 4 times in 12 years? From supporting Amaravati in 2014 to introducing MAVIGUN in 2026, YS Jagan’s shifting capital ideologies have put Andhra Pradesh's growth in a loop of uncertainty.
2014 నుండి 2026 వరకు.. ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ రాజధాని విషయంలో వైఎస్ జగన్ మోహన్ రెడ్డి గారి అస్థిరమైన, చంచలమైన వైఖరిని (Chaturvidha Vaikhari) ఎండగడుతూ చేసిన భౌగోళిక మరియు ఆర్థిక విశ్లేషణ ఇది. అమరావతి మద్దతు నుండి మొదలై.. మూడు రాజధానులు, వైజాగ్ ప్యాలెస్ రాజకీయం దాటి, ఇప్పుడు ఎన్నికల అస్త్రంగా తెచ్చిన "MAVIGUN" వెనుక ఉన్న అసలు నిజం ఏంటి?
గ్రేటర్ హైదరాబాద్ (110km Core) తో పోల్చితే 111km ట్రయాంగిల్ రూట్ కలిగిన అమరావతి-విజయవాడ-గుంటూరు పరిధిలో Greater Amaravati Capital City సాధ్యమేనా? మచిలీపట్నం కనెక్టివిటీ లోపాలు ఏంటి? పూర్తి వివరాల కోసం వీడియో చివరి వరకు చూడండి!

item.title: NAYAKUDU: Rajakeeyam Ranku Pulimithe | The Leader’s Final Promise | ThirdEye
item.description:
CONCEPT, SCRIPT & DIRECTION: Pradeep Pasupuleti
VISUAL ARCHITECTURE & LOOK DEVELOPMENT (3D Sculpting, Environments, Lighting): Pradeep & Rudramsh
ORIGINAL SCORE & SOUNDSCAPE (Music, SFX, Audio Mixing) Advaita.
TECHNICAL DIRECTION & RENDERING: Pradeep & Rudramsh
A ThirdEye VIRTUAL PRODUCTION Powered by Unreal Engine
POST-PRODUCTION, COMPOSITING & COLOR GRADING Adobe Creative Suite Nayakudu Song Lyrics: [Verse 1] అబద్దాల పునాది పైన, అరుపు - పోరు అవ్వునా? అనర్గళముగా భ్రమలు అల్లిన - కాల కర్మను ఆపునా? బ్రహ్మ విష్ణువు కలసి వచ్చిన - సత్యమును కబళించున? రాజాకీయం రంకు పులిమితే, నాయకుడికది అంటున?
[Verse 2] అన్నిటికి గిరిగీసి చూపే - మూర్ఖపు పిడి వాదము అణువ అణువు, అహంకారము - విచ్చలవిడి మద వైరము కణ కణం కపటంబు నిండిన - వికృత కలి విన్యాసము రాజాకీయం రంకు పులిమితే, నాయకుడికది అంటున?
Bridge: ఓరుగల్లును తరుముకొచ్చే కాల వాహిని – పవనము జై జై జై అని నభమై పొంగెను - ప్రజాగళ శంఖారవం!
మింటికుందో యేమొగానీ.. కంటికేదీ పరిమితి? దిక్కుకుందో యేమొగానీ.. మొక్కుకేదీ పరిమితి? భాషకుందో యేమొగానీ.. ధ్యానకేదీ పరిమితి? శ్వాసకుందో యేమొగానీ.. ఆశకేదీ పరిమితి?
[Verse 3] చేదు సత్యం మింగగలిగితె జీవితం వైద్యాలయం మనసు పుటలను చదవగలిగితే అనుభవం విద్యాలయం. క్రాంతి భవితను దర్శించగలిగితే, ఆత్మయే పరిపూర్ణము!
ఇదంతా…. కనులు తిప్పక చూడగలిగితె ఆణువణువు తత్వాలయం. అప్పుడు…. భద్రం భద్రం భద్రమని దీవించు - భద్ర-కాళీ మంగళం! ఇది భద్ర-కాళీ శాసనం…భద్ర-కాళీ మంగళం… ప్రచంఢ కాళీ శాసనం… శవారూఢాం మహాభీమాం.. ఘోరదంష్ట్రాం శివంకరీ….
[Final Chorus] భద్రా ముద్రా శివంకరీ! భద్రా ముద్రా శివంకరీ! భద్రా ముద్రా శివంకరీ!
Politics often obscures the path, but true leadership illuminates it. When Pawan Kalyan stepped away from the noise to fulfill a follower's last wish, he transcended the traditional political narrative. This was not a calculated PR move; it was an act of Dharma a promise kept in the silence of truth.
In a system where "politics swallows everything," we search for the exceptions. This cinematic essay anchors its perspective in the lyrical depth of Dr. C. Narayana Reddy and the philosophical sharpness of Sri Garikipati Narasimha Rao. We examine the anatomy of a promise and the legacy of a leader who listens when others are too busy speaking.
This visual journey is a ThirdEye Virtual Production, crafted in real-time using Unreal Engine and finished with precision grading to reflect the gravity of the subject. This is not just a report; it is an investigation into the moral fabric of leadership. Its a Statement.

item.title: Snake Relation 🐍
Paper Girls
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Paper Girls.

Paper Girls follows four young girls who, while out delivering papers on the morning after Halloween in 1988, become unwittingly caught in a conflict between warring factions of time-travelers, sending them on an adventure through time that will save the world. As they travel between our present, the past, and the future — they encounter future versions of themselves and now must choose to embrace or reject their fate. An emotional adventure in which the girls and the women they eventually become are tough, their friendships are authentic, and their journey through time is epic.

item.title: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed.

Paula, a newly divorced mom, falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer.

Convinced she witnessed a crime — while simultaneously struggling through a custody battle and an identity crisis — Paula begins her own investigation, one that could unravel a greater conspiracy while also holding the keys to rebuilding her family and sense of self.

item.title: Drops of God
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Drops of God.

Drops of God is set in the world of gastronomy and fine wines, which are in mourning as Alexandre Léger, creator of the famous Léger Wine Guide and emblematic figure in oenology, has just passed away at his home in Tokyo at the age of 60. He left behind a daughter, Camille, who lives in Paris and hasn't seen her father since her parents separated when she was nine years old. When Camille flies to Tokyo and Léger's will is read, she discovers that her father has left her an extraordinary wine collection – the greatest collection in the world according to the experts. But, to claim the inheritance, Camille must compete with a brilliant young oenologist, Issei Tomine, who her father took under his wing and is referred to in Léger's will as his "spiritual son." But is his connection to Issei only spiritual?

item.title: Cape Fear
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Cape Fear.

A storm is coming for happily married attorneys Anna and Tom Bowden when Max Cady, the notorious killer they are responsible for putting behind bars, is let out of prison - and he wants vengeance.

item.title: R.J. Decker
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: R.J. Decker.

R.J. Decker centers on the eponymous R.J. Decker, a disgraced newspaper photographer and ex-con who starts over as a private investigator in the colorful-if-crime-filled world of South Florida, tackling cases that range from slightly odd to outright bizarre with the help of his journalist ex, her police detective wife, and a shadowy new benefactor, a woman from his past who could be his greatest ally... or his one-way ticket back to prison.

item.title: Star City
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Star City.

Star City is a propulsive, paranoid thriller that takes us back to the key moment in the alt-history retelling of the space race — when the Soviet Union became the first nation to put a man on the moon. But this time, we explore the story from behind the Iron Curtain, showing the lives of the cosmonauts, the engineers and the intelligence officers embedded among them in the Soviet space program, and the risks they all took to propel humanity forward.

item.description:
Mango Farmer Story | Final Decision | Dubai | India GDP | Youngsters | Dr. Ravikanth Kongara --*****-- గత 12 సంవత్సరాలుగా రెండు తెలుగు రాష్ట్రాల ప్రజలకి అత్యాధునిక ప్రమాణాలతో సరికొత్త ఆధునిక వైద్య సేవలని డాక్టర్ కొంగర రవికాంత్ గారు అందిస్తున్నారు. విజయవాడలోని వారి కర్పోరేట్ స్థాయి హాస్పటల్లో తమ విశేష అనుభవంతో సామాన్యులకి కూడా అందుబాటులో ఉండే నాణ్యమైన వైద్య సేవలు అందిస్తూ గొప్ప పేరు సాదించారు.
అన్ని రకాల గ్యాస్ట్రో, బేరియాట్రిక్ సర్జరీ, లాపరోస్కోపీ సమస్యలకి చికిత్స అందిస్తూ దక్షిణ భారతదేశంలోనే నెలకు అత్యధిక బేరియాట్రిక్ సర్జరీలు చేస్తు గొప్ప ఫలితాలు సాదించారు. అంతేగాక 200 నుండి 250 కిలోల కంటే ఎక్కువ బరువున్న అత్యంత ప్రమాదకర బేరియాట్రిక్ సమస్యకి శస్త్రచికిత్స చేసి అసాధ్యాన్ని సుసాధ్యం చేసారు. సుమారు 200 కిలోల కంటే ఎక్కువ బరువున్న సూపర్ ఒబేసిటీ పేషెంట్లు మంచి ఫలితాలని పొందారు.
విజయవాడలో మొట్ట మొదటిసారిగా విదేశి తరహాలో అత్యాధునిక సౌకర్యాలతో 24 గంటలు వైద్యుల పర్యావేక్షణలో వైద్య సేవలు అందిస్తున్నారు. 100 పడకలతో పాటు అత్యవసర సమయంలో ఆంబులెన్స్ సౌకర్యం కలదు.

item.title: Ethanol (E20) PETROL బంక్‌లో జరుగుతున్న భారీ SCAM!? - ₹35,587 కోట్లు సామాన్యుడి జేబుకు కన్నం?
item.description:
మీరు బంక్‌లో ₹100 పెట్రోల్ కొట్టిస్తే, మీ బండిలోకి వెళ్లేది నిజంగా ₹100 విలువైన పెట్రోలేనా? ⛽️🤔
చాలామందికి తెలియని షాకింగ్ నిజం ఏంటంటే—ఈరోజు మీరు కొట్టించే ప్రతి లీటర్ పెట్రోల్‌లో 20% ఈథేనాల్ కలుపుతున్నారు. దీనివల్ల మీ బండి మైలేజీ తగ్గడమే కాదు, సామాన్యుడి జేబుకు కన్నం పడుతోంది. ప్రభుత్వ లెక్కల ప్రకారం దాదాపు ₹35,587 కోట్ల "సైలెంట్ స్కాం" (Silent Scam) జరుగుతోందా?
ఈ వీడియోలో మీరు తెలుసుకోబోయే విషయాలు: ✅ పెట్రోల్‌లో 20% అసలు పెట్రోల్ ఎందుకు ఉండటం లేదు? ✅ ఈథేనాల్ బ్లెండింగ్ వల్ల మీ బండి మైలేజీ ఎందుకు తగ్గుతుంది? ✅ ప్రభుత్వం ఈ ప్లాన్ ఎందుకు వేసింది? దీని వెనుక ఉన్న అసలు కారణం ఏంటి? ✅ నీటి ఎద్దడి & రైతు పరిస్థితి - ఒకసారి ఆలోచించండి!
ఒక్కటే ప్రశ్న—మనం అభివృద్ధి వైపు వెళ్తున్నామా? లేక మరో సంక్షోభాన్ని కొని తెచ్చుకుంటున్నామా?
మీ అభిప్రాయాన్ని కామెంట్ చేయండి! 👇

item.title: No Data, No AI – Why Data Analytics Matters | Live Session 2
item.description:
Welcome to Session 2 of our Data Analytics Demo! 🚀
If you missed our first session, don't worry—you're jumping in at the perfect time. In this stream, we are tackling a fundamental truth in the modern tech landscape: AI is only as good as the data it trains on. Without robust data analytics, even the most advanced Artificial Intelligence algorithms are virtually useless.
Today, we break down exactly why data analytics serves as the critical foundation for AI success.
📌 What We’ll Cover Today: The Data-AI Connection: Why AI completely relies on high-quality data infrastructure.
Garbage In, Garbage Out: How poor data quality breaks AI models and leads to flawed business insights.
The Role of Data Analytics: How parsing, cleaning, and analyzing data prepares it to power intelligent automation.
Live Walkthrough/Examples: Real-world scenarios demonstrating data analytics driving successful AI implementations.
Whether you are an aspiring data scientist, a business leader looking to implement AI, or just curious about the future of tech, this session will give you a clear roadmap of how data and AI work hand-in-hand.

item.title: Spider-Noir
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Spider-Noir.

Spider-Noir tells the story of Ben Reilly, a seasoned, down on his luck private investigator in 1930s New York, who is forced to grapple with his past life, following a deeply personal tragedy, as the city's one and only superhero.

item.title: Ponies
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Ponies.

Moscow, 1977. Two "PONIES" ("persons of no interest" in intelligence speak) work anonymously as secretaries in the American Embassy. That is until their husbands are killed under mysterious circumstances in the USSR, and the pair become CIA operatives. Bea is an over educated, Russian speaking child of Soviet immigrants. Her cohort, Twila, is a small town girl who is as abrasive as she is fearless. Together, they work to uncover a vast Cold War conspiracy and solve the mystery that made them widows in the first place.

In Best Medicine a brilliant surgeon leaves Boston to become a small-town doctor where he spent childhood summers. Despite his medical skills, his rude manner alienates locals as he battles hidden phobias and struggles with personal connections.

item.title: Widow's Bay
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Widow's Bay.

Widow's Bay is about a mysteriously cursed New England island and its superstitious citizens, led by a mayor who refuses to believe their warnings.

item.title: Margo's Got Money Troubles
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Margo's Got Money Troubles.

Margo Millet is the daughter of a Hooters waitress and an ex-pro wrestler. Now an unemployed single mother in her early 20s, Margo is struggling to make ends meet, leading her to launch an OnlyFans account. When her father reenters her life, she starts incorporating his lessons from the pro wrestling world into her OnlyFans work, leading to unexpected success.

item.title: Dutton Ranch
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Dutton Ranch.

The Dutton Ranch, home to Beth Dutton and Rip Wheeler, is a testament to the peace they sought, fought for, and nearly died for, as they've come to cherish their 7,000-acre land. With tough times and stiff competition, Beth and Rip do what they must to survive, all while ensuring Carter becomes the man he's supposed to be.

As Beth and Rip fight to build a future together - far from the ghosts of Yellowstone - they collide with brutal new realities and a ruthless rival ranch that will stop at nothing to protect its empire. In South Texas, blood runs deeper, forgiveness is fleeting, and the cost of survival might just be your soul.

Which Surgery is Best? | Laparoscopy Surgery | Open Surgery | Robotic Surgery | Dr.Ravikanth Kongara --*****-- గత 12 సంవత్సరాలుగా రెండు తెలుగు రాష్ట్రాల ప్రజలకి అత్యాధునిక ప్రమాణాలతో సరికొత్త ఆధునిక వైద్య సేవలని డాక్టర్ కొంగర రవికాంత్ గారు అందిస్తున్నారు. విజయవాడలోని వారి కర్పోరేట్ స్థాయి హాస్పటల్లో తమ విశేష అనుభవంతో సామాన్యులకి కూడా అందుబాటులో ఉండే నాణ్యమైన వైద్య సేవలు అందిస్తూ గొప్ప పేరు సాదించారు.
అన్ని రకాల గ్యాస్ట్రో, బేరియాట్రిక్ సర్జరీ, లాపరోస్కోపీ సమస్యలకి చికిత్స అందిస్తూ దక్షిణ భారతదేశంలోనే నెలకు అత్యధిక బేరియాట్రిక్ సర్జరీలు చేస్తు గొప్ప ఫలితాలు సాదించారు. అంతేగాక 200 నుండి 250 కిలోల కంటే ఎక్కువ బరువున్న అత్యంత ప్రమాదకర బేరియాట్రిక్ సమస్యకి శస్త్రచికిత్స చేసి అసాధ్యాన్ని సుసాధ్యం చేసారు. సుమారు 200 కిలోల కంటే ఎక్కువ బరువున్న సూపర్ ఒబేసిటీ పేషెంట్లు మంచి ఫలితాలని పొందారు.
విజయవాడలో మొట్ట మొదటిసారిగా విదేశి తరహాలో అత్యాధునిక సౌకర్యాలతో 24 గంటలు వైద్యుల పర్యావేక్షణలో వైద్య సేవలు అందిస్తున్నారు. 100 పడకలతో పాటు అత్యవసర సమయంలో ఆంబులెన్స్ సౌకర్యం కలదు.
Dr. Ravikanth Kongara MBBS, MS, DNB(Gastro-NIMS) Ravi Hospital, Bariatric, gastro, laparoscopy, Swathi Press - opp Kovelamudi Street, Suryaraopeta, Vijayawada - 2, Andhra Pradesh: 520002, Phone: 0888 183 8888, 888 184 8888. https://g.co/kgs/XJHvYA
Health Disclaimer: ___________________ The information in this Video is Designed for EDUCATIONAL Purpose Only. It is not intended to be a substitute for informed medical advice or care. You Should not use this information to diagnose or treat any health problems. Please consult a doctor with any questions or concerns you might have regarding your or your child's condition.

item.description:
Is it good to use ChatGPT for medical advice? | How to use? | Patient Story | Dr. Ravikanth Kongara --*****-- గత 12 సంవత్సరాలుగా రెండు తెలుగు రాష్ట్రాల ప్రజలకి అత్యాధునిక ప్రమాణాలతో సరికొత్త ఆధునిక వైద్య సేవలని డాక్టర్ కొంగర రవికాంత్ గారు అందిస్తున్నారు. విజయవాడలోని వారి కర్పోరేట్ స్థాయి హాస్పటల్లో తమ విశేష అనుభవంతో సామాన్యులకి కూడా అందుబాటులో ఉండే నాణ్యమైన వైద్య సేవలు అందిస్తూ గొప్ప పేరు సాదించారు.
అన్ని రకాల గ్యాస్ట్రో, బేరియాట్రిక్ సర్జరీ, లాపరోస్కోపీ సమస్యలకి చికిత్స అందిస్తూ దక్షిణ భారతదేశంలోనే నెలకు అత్యధిక బేరియాట్రిక్ సర్జరీలు చేస్తు గొప్ప ఫలితాలు సాదించారు. అంతేగాక 200 నుండి 250 కిలోల కంటే ఎక్కువ బరువున్న అత్యంత ప్రమాదకర బేరియాట్రిక్ సమస్యకి శస్త్రచికిత్స చేసి అసాధ్యాన్ని సుసాధ్యం చేసారు. సుమారు 200 కిలోల కంటే ఎక్కువ బరువున్న సూపర్ ఒబేసిటీ పేషెంట్లు మంచి ఫలితాలని పొందారు.
విజయవాడలో మొట్ట మొదటిసారిగా విదేశి తరహాలో అత్యాధునిక సౌకర్యాలతో 24 గంటలు వైద్యుల పర్యావేక్షణలో వైద్య సేవలు అందిస్తున్నారు. 100 పడకలతో పాటు అత్యవసర సమయంలో ఆంబులెన్స్ సౌకర్యం కలదు.

అన్ని రకాల గ్యాస్ట్రో, బేరియాట్రిక్ సర్జరీ, లాపరోస్కోపీ సమస్యలకి చికిత్స అందిస్తూ దక్షిణ భారతదేశంలోనే నెలకు అత్యధిక బేరియాట్రిక్ సర్జరీలు చేస్తు గొప్ప ఫలితాలు సాదించారు. అంతేగాక 200 నుండి 250 కిలోల కంటే ఎక్కువ బరువున్న అత్యంత ప్రమాదకర బేరియాట్రిక్ సమస్యకి శస్త్రచికిత్స చేసి అసాధ్యాన్ని సుసాధ్యం చేసారు. సుమారు 200 కిలోల కంటే ఎక్కువ బరువున్న సూపర్ ఒబేసిటీ పేషెంట్లు మంచి ఫలితాలని పొందారు.
విజయవాడలో మొట్ట మొదటిసారిగా విదేశి తరహాలో అత్యాధునిక సౌకర్యాలతో 24 గంటలు వైద్యుల పర్యావేక్షణలో వైద్య సేవలు అందిస్తున్నారు. 100 పడకలతో పాటు అత్యవసర సమయంలో ఆంబులెన్స్ సౌకర్యం కలదు.
Dr. Ravikanth Kongara MBBS, MS, DNB(Gastro-NIMS) Ravi Hospital, Bariatric, gastro, laparoscopy, Swathi Press - opp Kovelamudi Street, Suryaraopeta, Vijayawada - 2, Andhra Pradesh: 520002, Phone: 0888 183 8888, 888 184 8888. https://g.co/kgs/XJHvYA
Health Disclaimer: ___________________ The information in this Video is Designed for EDUCATIONAL Purpose Only. It is not intended to be a substitute for informed medical advice or care. You Should not use this information to diagnose or treat any health problems. Please consult a doctor with any questions or concerns you might have regarding your or your child's condition.
